verdict.rationale: Fern's own design keeps documentation content in open formats. Pages are written in Markdown, API references are generated from OpenAPI specs, and the content lives in the customer's own source repository. Fern also serves clean Markdown for any page and supports a self-hosted container, which makes the core content portable. However, no dedicated export or offboarding capability is documented, and there is nothing on exporting platform-held data such as analytics, reader feedback or Ask Fern history. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, export of analytics/feedback/Ask Fern data, an explicit offboarding/no-lock-in statement, and independent corroboration of leaving cleanly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Fern supports writing pages in Markdown and generating API Reference documentation from an OpenAPI specification.
